396 -> 0. odoo.tools reaches zero, and the 396 was 398 by the time it fell.

THE FLOOR WAS ALREADY RED, RISING, AND NOT BY DRIFT IN THIS PACKAGE. It banked
396; HEAD measures 398. The two extra are in mixin_profiler.py and were
surfaced by work in other packages -- mypy propagates inference across files,
so a scope can gain a diagnostic no change of its own produced. Subtracting a
delta from 396 would have banked two too low.

WHAT THE 398 WERE. The baseline this replaces predicted it: 69 annotations said
`: object` for what is an Environment, a BaseCursor, a FrameType, an IO stream
or a Callable, and an annotation that says `object` asserts nothing while
looking as though it does. `TranslationFileWriter` returned `object`, so every
`writer.write_rows(...)` was an error; one Protocol closed the family.

One was a plain misdescription rather than a weak one:
`_get_translatable_records(imd_records)` was typed `BaseModel`, and every
caller passes `dict_values[int, ImdInfo]` -- a NamedTuple collection, not a
recordset. The checker was reporting that the code said something false.

Where a recordset's MODEL IS CHOSEN FROM DATA at runtime -- `env[model].browse`
with `model` read out of ir_model_data -- the annotation is `Any` and that is
the honest one: `BaseModel` would assert that only base attributes are touched,
which is not true of `.res_id`, `.module` or `.field_id`.

Measured per section 9.3: fresh venv holding mypy==2.3.0 and nothing else,
`--no-incremental`, `-p odoo.tools`, in a detached worktree at 7142a3bc8a5.
Pristine control 398, with these files 0.
